description: SQL from a question and a schema (CREATE TABLE statements or a JSON description of tables and columns), for postgres (default), mysql, sqlite or bigquery. The tables and columns used are checked against the schema; a query that does not match it is retried once, then refused. Writes (INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, DDL) are refused unless allowWrite is true. The query is not run. Price: $0.003 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

allowWrite.description: Allow INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE or DDL (default false)

schema.description: CREATE TABLE statements, or a JSON object of tables and column lists (max 20,000 characters)
